tool_scope_this_round: Implement and synthetically accept observation primitives, store/verifier/run adapters and independent publisher wrapper. No real-data runner is invoked; integration into a supervised real measurement is a separate next step.

measurement_plan.mode_R: Original V4 verifier and V6 store; original SQL, no new fine observers.
measurement_plan.mode_D: Same original V4/V6/V2 bytecode with invocation-local context/catalog and source descriptor observers; no global monkeypatch.
measurement_plan.interpretation: Diagnostic observer effect only, not an optimization candidate or a 5% adoption gate. Report all pairs, warmups excluded from pair summaries.
measurement_plan.deadline_rule: One original absolute deadline for worker and independent publisher; no reset or second faster run; failure/expiry preserves evidence and withholds successful publication.

telemetry.coverage: complete entry of every R/D run; start/end and nonoverlap checked; publisher context separate

measurement_plan.scientific_gates: Every run must match all original48 complete payloads, physical frames and logical workload; full validation/test remain locked.

observation_plan.clock: monotonic perf_counter_ns wall clock; no inferred CPU wait or I/O ratio
observation_plan.tree: invocation-local event tree with start/end, parent, completion and error type; child intervals nested and disjoint siblings; exclusive residual retains dispatch/clock overhead
observation_plan.closure: Call original verify_bindings bytecode with original describe wrapped once per actual operation; track attempts/completed calls and successful logical byte coverage separately from unique descriptors; no extra read/stat/hash.
observation_plan.checkpoint: Observe create/open, whole writer lifetime and entry acquisition separately; preserve force=True source check after OS lock; _check_sources calls original CP bytecode with original verify_sources/descriptor individually observed.
observation_plan.verifier: Clone original V4 with call-local module views; original load_context and prepare_catalog wrappers plus original verifier outer/setup clock taps; no ranking SQL proxy, batching, caching or source-check suppression.
observation_plan.run: Wrap original V22 _run bytecode using a per-call store factory and original native V4 verifier; observe original proof and output writes. Its original entry timer and parent wall are distinct.
observation_plan.publisher: Wrap independent publisher callable from entry through return/exception, including its final publication writes when performed inside callback; nested closure/open/proof operations use explicit bound observers. Emit observation receipt after timer ends and account receipt serialization outside publisher span; no self-referential timing/hash.
observation_plan.privacy: Private event traces retain paths and descriptor hashes; public summary only phase/purpose/count/bytes/timing; source identities, data/model files and PIDs remain ignored.

acceptance.differential: Complete four-arm synthetic payload/workload and deterministic checkpoint bytes must equal unobserved originals. Also exercise a synthetic48 run and independent publisher/fault path.
required_faults: change between create and writer lock
failure while holding writer lock and recovery
external source verifier delegation and original cache/force behavior
acceptance.integrity: No module/class global changes; no added/suppressed original source operations, file opens or watch calls; failed calls remain failed and evidence retained.
acceptance.cost: Exact event tree containment and logical call accounting; original V6/V23 nested commit/budget definitions remain unchanged.
acceptance.real_input_access: This round verifies only sealed small evidence/method bytes. Artificial fixtures only; original large model/data are not rehashed or ranked.
